class.name: OpenXRSpatialCapabilityConfigurationImageTracking
class.description: Configuration header for image tracking. Pass this to [method OpenXRSpatialEntityExtension.create_spatial_context] to create a spatial context that can detect images.

method.name: add_image_tracking_database
method.description: Adds this image tracking database to our configuration. Images held in this database will be detected. Call [method OpenXRSpatialImageTrackingCapability.image_database_create] to create an image database. The image database must be submitted before adding to the configuration.

method.name: get_enabled_components
method.description: Lists components that are enabled by this configuration (list is only valid after configuration object has been used to create a spatial context).

method.name: remove_image_tracking_database
method.description: Remove this image tracking database from our configuration.
